form.label: Linux Common OS Syslog - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed Linux /var/log and syslog relay overview for sshd success/failure, sudo, su/PAM session/auth-failure, cron, kernel, systemd, syslog-wrapped package-manager, and shadow-utils account/group administration records. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures and Splunk props; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=osnix (sourcetype="linux:os:auth:sshd" OR sourcetype="linux:os:auth:sudo" OR sourcetype="linux:os:auth:su" OR sourcetype="linux:os:cron" OR sourcetype="linux:os:kernel" OR sourcetype="linux:os:systemd" OR sourcetype="linux:os:package" OR sourcetype="linux:os:account") host=$host_tok$ | stats count
index=osnix (sourcetype="linux:os:auth:sshd" OR sourcetype="linux:os:auth:su") host=$host_tok$ result="failure" | stats count

index=osnix (sourcetype="linux:os:auth:sshd" OR sourcetype="linux:os:auth:sudo" OR sourcetype="linux:os:auth:su" OR sourcetype="linux:os:cron" OR sourcetype="linux:os:kernel" OR sourcetype="linux:os:systemd" OR sourcetype="linux:os:package" OR sourcetype="linux:os:account") host=$host_tok$ | eval linux_os_family=case(sourcetype="linux:os:auth:sshd","sshd_auth",sourcetype="linux:os:auth:sudo","sudo",sourcetype="linux:os:auth:su","su_pam",sourcetype="linux:os:cron","cron",sourcetype="linux:os:kernel","kernel",sourcetype="linux:os:systemd","systemd",sourcetype="linux:os:package","package_manager",sourcetype="linux:os:account","account_mgmt",true(),sourcetype) | stats count by linux_os_family | sort -count

index=osnix (sourcetype="linux:os:auth:sshd" OR sourcetype="linux:os:auth:sudo" OR sourcetype="linux:os:auth:su" OR sourcetype="linux:os:cron" OR sourcetype="linux:os:kernel" OR sourcetype="linux:os:systemd" OR sourcetype="linux:os:package" OR sourcetype="linux:os:account") host=$host_tok$ | stats count by action result signature | sort -count | head 20

index=osnix (sourcetype="linux:os:auth:sshd" OR sourcetype="linux:os:auth:sudo" OR sourcetype="linux:os:auth:su" OR sourcetype="linux:os:cron") host=$host_tok$ | eval linux_user=coalesce(user,dest_user) | stats count values(dest_user) as target_users values(action) as actions by linux_user | sort -count | head 20

panel.title: Top SSH and kernel source IPs

search.query: index=osnix (sourcetype="linux:os:auth:sshd" OR sourcetype="linux:os:kernel") host=$host_tok$ src_ip=* | stats count values(src_port) as src_ports values(dest_ip) as dest_ips values(dest_port) as dest_ports values(transport) as transports by src_ip | sort -count | head 20

index=osnix sourcetype="linux:os:auth:sshd" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host program process_id action result auth_method user src_ip src src_port transport signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=osnix (sourcetype="linux:os:auth:sudo" OR sourcetype="linux:os:cron") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype program process_id action result user dest_user terminal working_directory command signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=osnix sourcetype="linux:os:auth:su" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host program process_id action result user user_uid dest_user dest_user_uid pam_service pam_event pam_logname effective_uid terminal ruser rhost src_ip signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=osnix sourcetype="linux:os:package" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host program process_id action result package_action package_name package_version package_arch signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=osnix sourcetype="linux:os:account" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host program process_id action result account_action account_name account_uid account_gid account_home account_shell account_source account_attribute account_old_value account_new_value signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=osnix sourcetype="linux:os:kernel" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host program action src_ip src src_port dest_ip dest dest_port transport signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100
index=osnix sourcetype="linux:os:systemd" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host program process_id action service service_message signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=osnix (sourcetype="linux:os:auth:sshd" OR sourcetype="linux:os:auth:sudo" OR sourcetype="linux:os:auth:su" OR sourcetype="linux:os:cron" OR sourcetype="linux:os:kernel" OR sourcetype="linux:os:systemd" OR sourcetype="linux:os:package" OR sourcetype="linux:os:account") host=$host_tok$ | stats count dc(marker) as fixture_markers min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -count
